title: Deliver tenant-safe Agora dataset handoff
summary: Completed tenant-safe Agora interaction, evidence extraction, DatasetVersion, and durable handoff path with correlated identifiers, strict multi-tenant isolation, and idempotent ack.

acceptance.criterion: Persist one tenant-scoped Agora interaction and its evidence through the production store
acceptance.evidence: AgoraInteractionEvidenceRequest submitted via POST /bff/agora/interaction-evidence persists DatasetRecord into agora_dataset_records / memory store with immutable governance proofs.

acceptance.criterion: Create a DatasetVersion and durable downstream handoff with correlated identifiers
acceptance.evidence: extract_evidence and process_inbox create dsv-... DatasetVersion and gh-... durable handoff containing correlated evidence_ids and authority_limit='Observe/Learn'.

acceptance.criterion: Prove a second tenant cannot read acknowledge replay or correlate the first tenant records
acceptance.evidence: Tenant B receives 404 when querying Tenant A's evidence_id, 0 items in datasets/observe listing and dataset-worker/handoffs, and 404 on ack and replay attempts.

acceptance.criterion: Keep retry and duplicate publication idempotent while preserving backlog truth
acceptance.evidence: Duplicate evidence submission with same Idempotency-Key returns 201 with idempotent=true and status='exists'. Acking handoff twice returns idempotent=true. Conflicting payloads or version mismatch return 409.

acceptance.criterion: Implement any missing current source edge before evidence
acceptance.evidence: All interaction kinds (ask, feedback, journal, note, insight, training_example) preserve source_refs, persona_id, session_id, and learning_eligible flags.

acceptance.criterion: Land one independently reviewed PR with executable service-boundary proof
acceptance.evidence: Executable service-boundary test suite services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_agora_dataset_handoff_integration.py passes 5/5 tests cleanly.

validation.result: 141 passed, 4 skipped across all Agora dataset, isolation matrix, and integration test suites.
